text.body:
oṃ namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisattvebhyaḥ ||
evaṃ mayā śrutam ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma | gṛddhrakūṭe parvate | pūrvajinādhyuṣite | mahācaitye | tathāgatādhiṣṭhānādhiṣṭhite dharaṇīmaṇḍe bodhisatvābhiṣṭute dharmāsane | devanāgayakṣagandharvanamaskṛte pṛthivīpradeśe | kuśalamūlasaṃcodane | tathāgataprabhave dharmamukhābhilapane | bodhisatvaprabhave |
apramāṇaguṇasamudgate tathāgatagocare | bhagavān sarvadharmasamatābhisaṃbuddhaḥ supravartitadharmacakraḥ anantaśiṣyagaṇasuvinītaḥ sarvadharmavaśitāprāptaḥ sarvasattvāśayasuvidhijñaḥ indriyaparamapāramiprāptaḥ sarvasattvavāsanānusandhisamudghātanakuśalaḥ anābhogabuddhakāryāpratiprasrabdhaḥ mahatā bhikṣusaṅghena sārdham |
ṣaṣṭābhikṣuśatasahasraiḥ sarvair ājāneyaiḥ saṃmyagājñāsuvimuktacittaiḥ sarvakleśavāsanānusandhisamudghātitaiḥ tathāgatadharmarājaputraiḥ gambhīradharmavihārakuśalaiḥ anupalambhadharmaniryātaiḥ prāsādikeryāpathasaṃpannaiḥ mahādakṣinīyabhūtaiḥ tathāgatājñāsupratipannaiḥ aprameyena ca bodhisattvasaṅghena sārdham asaṅgagocarasarvajñatāniryātair
bodhisattvaiḥ mahāsattvaiḥ mahāmaitrīmahākaruṇādharmameghavipaśyanāvidyāvimuktividyotitaiḥ sudhājaladharābhipravarṣaṇasarvajagatsaṃtarpayitṛbhiḥ sarvasattvadharaṇisamacittaiḥ anunayapratighavigataiḥ vividhabodhipakṣyadharmaśasyasaṃpravardhayitṛbhiḥ
sūryamaṇḍalātirekaprajñāraśmipramuktamohāndhakāravidhamanamārgālokaprāptasaṃdarśanasattvapadmavibodhanakuśalamūlaparipācanatṛṣṇāsalilocchoṣaṇajñānakarmāntaprasthāpanamahābhijñārāmapathacāribhiḥ candropamasarvajagatsamacittābhiśamanāśayasaṃtoṣaṇopāyakauśalyahānivṛddhisandarśakaiḥ
sumerukalpādhyāśayasupratiṣṭhitacaturbrāhmavihāraratnacatuḥpārśvasarvaviṣayavātāprakampyalokadharmābhyudgatasarvabuddhakṣetrasaṃdarśanāvabhāsagataiḥ mahāsamudrakalpadhāraṇīsmṛtivipulabhājanadharmasalilaparipūrṇabodhisattvacaryāratnasarvajagadupajīvyaiḥ
mṛgendravatsatyacaraṇapravṛddhamaitrīlāṅgūlaśamathavipaśyanālocanagambhīradharmānutrāsasarvaparapravādinirghātayatṛbhiḥ aparimitakalpaśatasahasrāparyantāpariniṣṭhitabodhisattvacaryāpratiprasrabdhasarvaguṇasamanvāgataiḥ |
tadyathā samantāvabhāsānāvaraṇadarśinā ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | sarvakṣetrālaṃkāravyūhasaṃdarśakena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | tathāgatagotrasambhavācāramatinā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | sarveryāpathavinītāvikopanasaṃdarśakena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena |
anantapratibhānaketudhvajavikurvitaghoṣeṇa ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | śubhakanakanicitaprabhātejoraśminā ca bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | prajñāviniścayapadapratibhānena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena | aparimitapuṇyajñānasaṃbhāropastambhopacitena ca nāma bodhisattvena mahāsattvena |
evaṃpramukhair aprameyair bodhisattvair mahāsattvaiḥ sārdham |
tatra khalu bhagavān bodhisattvacaryāprasthānaniryāṇānāvaraṇamukhaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ samprakāśayati sma |
atha khalu bhagavataḥ ṣoḍaśavarṣābhisaṃbuddhasya brahmacaryavaistārikatāṃ viditvā taṃ ca mahāntaṃ bodhisattvasaṃnipātam viditvā tathāgatadharmagañjadharā bateme bodhisattvāḥ saṃnipatitāḥ iti viditvā etad abhavad yan nv ahaṃ bhūyasyā mātrayā bodhisattvānuparigrahāya |
bodhisattvacaryāprasthānaniryāṇānāvaraṇamukhaṃ nāma dharmaparyāyaṃ saṃprakāśayeyaṃ mahatā tathāgatavikurvitena mahatā tathāgataprātihāryeṇa yaduta bodhisattvānāṃ mahāsattvānāṃ tathāgataviṣayāvatāraṇatām upādāyeti |
atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ buddhaviṣayavikurvitayathāvatsandarśanaṃ (3r [missing]) nāma tathāgatasamādhiṃ samāpadyata |
